scope: read-only; no registry edits; no triage decisions; no promotion or install
matching: GitHub owner/repo. STRONG: repo name equals candidate_id, source_item_id or name. URL: slug appears in registry item JSON. WEAK: a distinctive repo-name token (4+ chars, not generic) appears as a whole word in registry text; review only, never a match.

statusMeaning.MATCHED_STRONG: exactly one registry item has the repo name as its id, source id or name
statusMeaning.MATCHED_BY_URL: owner/repo appears in exactly one registry item and no strong key matched
statusMeaning.AMBIGUOUS_URL: owner/repo appears in two or more registry items
statusMeaning.AMBIGUOUS_STRONG: repo name matches several registry items as id/name
statusMeaning.WEAK_ONLY_REVIEW: only a shared word token overlaps; not a match
statusMeaning.NOT_FOUND_IN_REGISTRY: no registry link found; does NOT mean the product was lost
statusMeaning.NON_GITHUB_ORIGIN: origin is not a GitHub repo; needs a hand-written alias key
statusMeaning.NO_URL: no URL in the source row
